title: S4 slo lens — input
description: Unlike telemetry-cost/tracing/ops, the slo lens is NOT cross-cutting -- an SLO is defined per critical business journey, and the journeys ARE the routes (docs/decisions/011). points is filtered to http_server_route/declarative_route kinds by the caller.

points.description: surface_map.json points of kind http_server_route or declarative_route only -- the lens designs one SLO per distinguishable route/journey, not one per point.

context.description: context.yaml, if an interview has run -- this lens's own primary input for WHICH routes need an SLO at all: a route with no known-critical workflow is real service surface, but SLO effort should concentrate on p0/critical journeys first, named explicitly here rather than left implicit.
